My name is Grant and I am a mathematics student at the University of Warwick, interested in quantitative finance and machine learning.

I started this site as a place to organise what I'm learning, and I hope it's useful to others who are curious about the subject too. The notes follow the theory courses I'm taking, and I pair them with code to show how the ideas work in practice.
